note: tapFrac is [x, y] normalised SCREEN coordinates, origin TOP-LEFT. UI taps come straight from each control's RectTransform anchor inside DefaultPanel/Content (a full-screen rect), so screen x = anchorX and screen y = 1 - anchorY. Board taps are world points converted through the orthographic camera (size 5): the board cell is width-bound (cell = 2*halfW*0.92/8), which makes x aspect-invariant; the two y values are the midpoint of the 16:9 and 20:9 solutions so each tap stays inside its cell on both. The swap in steps 6-7 is the SOLVING swap for scheme 0 attempt 0 - (2,4) and (2,5) - computed by running SchemeGenerator headlessly, so step 8 LOCK IN raises the Win pop. Loader waits use waitLoader because both scenes show their own splash (menu: MainThreadUtil.LaunchGame, game: PanelController.SwitchSplash).

steps.label: overlay shade below the card - closes HOW TO PLAY
mirror stone at grid (2,4) - selects it
stone at grid (2,5) - swaps the pair, beams re-route
LOCK IN - verifies the route and raises the Win pop
